ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
073
Behind the image
25 / Scarlet Cut
REFERENCE 5782.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 021
Art direction: Bold red and black color block, sharp editorial tension, glossy leather detail.
Striking vertical fashion editorial of an original adult East Asian woman in three-quarter profile
with very long, sleek black hair falling down her back, looking off to the side with a cool, serious
expression and muted red lips. She wears a black sleeveless halter-neck top with a fully bare back
and long black glossy leather opera gloves, and holds a pair of silver tailor's scissors raised near
her shoulder as a stylized prop. Seamless solid deep scarlet red studio backdrop, soft directional
key light with crisp highlights on the leather, bold red and black palette, high-fashion magazine
photography, fine skin detail, no text or logos.
26 / Feather Back
REFERENCE 5781.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 022
Art direction: Evening elegance, flushed cheeks, black against pale mint, delicate gold accents.
Elegant vertical beauty-fashion portrait of an original adult East Asian woman with long, loose
black hair parted in the center, glancing back over her shoulder at the camera with soft, intense
dark eyes, rosy flushed cheeks and nude-pink lips. She wears a black draped long-sleeved evening
top with a deep open back and a small black feather accent on one shoulder, and a fine gold chain
across her bare back. Pale mint-gray seamless studio backdrop, soft diffused window light, airy
and cool color palette with natural skin texture, luxurious contemporary editorial, no text or logos.
